examples.normal: Her mother-in-law visits them every Sunday for lunch.
examples.hard: Many comedians tell jokes about mothers-in-law, but mine has always been very supportive.

examples.easy: I stayed for a short time.
examples.normal: He worked in London for a short time after university.
examples.hard: In such a short time, she managed to learn enough Turkish to talk to her neighbours.

examples.normal: The plane's propeller started to turn slowly.
examples.hard: The engineer checked every propeller carefully because even a small crack could cause a serious accident.

examples.normal: The glider flew silently over the valley.
examples.hard: Gliders have no engine, so pilots must use rising warm air to stay in the sky for hours.

examples.normal: Toiletries are at the other end of the shop, madam.
examples.hard: Remember that liquid toiletries in your hand luggage must be in small bottles of no more than 100 millilitres.

examples.normal: The water in the fish tank should be changed regularly.
examples.hard: Doctors say that people who walk regularly are less likely to suffer from heart disease later in life.

examples.normal: Loud music distracts me when I'm trying to study.
examples.hard: Phones can easily distract drivers, which is why using them at the wheel is against the law.

examples.normal: She put on her coat and told the children to do likewise.
examples.hard: My father always saved part of his salary, and he encouraged us to do likewise when we started work.

examples.normal: It must be hard to cope with three small children and a job.
examples.hard: After losing his job, he found it difficult to cope, but his family helped him through it.

examples.normal: Many students suffer from homesickness in their first month abroad.
examples.hard: A wave of homesickness swept over me when I smelt the bread, which reminded me of my mother's kitchen.

examples.normal: I don't eat meat, and my husband doesn't either.
examples.hard: She hadn't heard the news, and when I asked her colleagues, they didn't know about it either.

examples.normal: Nobody had much money then, and I was no exception.
examples.hard: Everyone must be at work by nine; the only exception is staff who have permission to start later.

examples.normal: Can you rewind the video so we can watch that goal again?
examples.hard: The teacher rewound the recording several times so that the students could catch every word.

examples.normal: I went downstairs to answer the phone.
examples.hard: We heard a strange noise downstairs in the middle of the night, so my husband went down to check.

examples.normal: You can earn extra money by doing overtime after six o'clock.
examples.hard: Nurses at the hospital have been working a lot of unpaid overtime since the new rules came in.

examples.easy: She balanced the book on her head.
examples.normal: She tries to balance her home life and her career.
examples.hard: It isn't easy to balance the needs of customers with the interests of shareholders.

examples.normal: Each of these systems has its advantages and disadvantages.
examples.hard: One big advantage of living in the city centre is that you can walk to work instead of driving.

examples.normal: It's very easy once you understand the concept.
examples.hard: The concept of working from home was quite new to many companies before 2020.

examples.normal: There are countryside walks to suit everyone.
examples.hard: We offer several payment plans, so you can choose the one that best suits your budget.

examples.normal: I hadn't seen her for twenty years, but I recognised her immediately.
examples.hard: He had changed so much since university that I didn't recognise him until he said my name.

examples.normal: Please don't interrupt her while she's working.
examples.hard: I'm sorry to interrupt, but there's an urgent call for you from the head office.

examples.easy: He is an apologist for the old system.
examples.normal: There are few apologists for the old system today.
examples.hard: Even the government's strongest apologists found it hard to defend the new tax.

examples.normal: I didn't really want to go, but he insisted.
examples.hard: She insisted that we stay for dinner, even though we had told her we were already late.

examples.normal: The government has promised to reduce taxes.
examples.hard: He promised his mother he would call every week, but after a month he forgot.

examples.easy: Prices reach a peak in summer.
examples.normal: Holiday flights reach a peak during August.
examples.hard: She was at the peak of her career when she decided to leave and start her own business.

examples.easy: The dove is a symbol of peace.
examples.normal: The wheel on the Indian flag is a symbol of peace.
examples.hard: For many people, the old bridge has become a symbol of the city's history and survival.

examples.normal: The first lecture I ever gave was a complete fiasco.
examples.hard: The launch turned into a fiasco when the website crashed and thousands of customers could not log in.

examples.easy: I tried to unscramble my thoughts.
examples.normal: It took a while to unscramble my thoughts after the news.
examples.hard: Investigators spent weeks trying to unscramble what had really happened on the night of the fire.

examples.normal: Scientists are working on a new vaccine against malaria.
examples.hard: The vaccine was tested on thousands of volunteers before it was approved for use in hospitals.

examples.normal: The whole trip, including fares, comes out at about £900.
examples.hard: When we added up the cost of food, petrol and hotels, the holiday came out at less than we expected.

examples.normal: She went on and on about her trip to Paris.
examples.hard: The meeting dragged on and on, and by the end nobody could remember what had been decided.

examples.easy: Get rid of that old sofa.
examples.normal: We got rid of all the old furniture before we moved.
examples.hard: It took me months to get rid of the cough I caught while travelling in the winter.

examples.normal: I tried to head the dog off by running towards it.
examples.hard: Police headed off the protesters before they could reach the parliament building.

examples.normal: I kept myself occupied by watching television.
examples.hard: With three children and a part-time job, she is fully occupied from morning till night.
